speaker: Devotee (bowing)
question: To whom bow — desire withdrawn?
premises: To desire-withdrawn, longing-stretched, to-stretching.
To moon-crested, to Soma, to master: bow.
inference: Bow to master Soma, desire withdrawn, moon-crested.

option_choices.reason: Longing-stretched (kāmā + āyati as stretched longing); prolonging is same duration, T1 kept.

speaker: Devotee (taking refuge)
question: What refuge for the incapable?
premises: 'What can I, incapable, do?' — for one resolving nothing anywhere.
All-befriending power, Śaṅkara's: my refuge.
inference: Śaṅkara's all-befriending power is refuge for the resolveless.

option_choices.reason: Same agent; of-resolving-nothing-anywhere kept as T1 genitive.

speaker: Devotee (questioning substitute)
question: What substitute for you?
premises: Of beyond-guṇas, whose self is utter excellence.
In which part, O Bhava, is a substitute of yours found?
inference: No part holds a substitute for you beyond guṇas.

option_choices.reason: Other (substitute other than you); supreme is same para, T1 other kept.
Substitute (standing in); representative is same pratinidhi, T1 kept.

speaker: Devotee (confessing deceit)
question: Why cheated though you are nondual?
premises: In nondual, in limitless — in you, in self being, O lord.
We are cheated even now by your unmeasured māyā.
inference: Though you are nondual self, your māyā cheats us still.

option_choices.reason: Unmeasured (not measured); unfathomable is same ameya, T1 kept.

speaker: Devotee (listing fruits)
question: What sprouts from devotion?
premises: Attainment of powers from aṇimā, eternal lordship, end of becoming.
These, O Bhava, are sprouts of devotion's wish-tree.
inference: Powers, lordship, and end of becoming sprout from devotion.

speaker: Devotee (pleading presence)
question: When will you be won?
premises: Whatever quarter, there never absent; all time made of you.
Thus already won, yet when will you be won, O lord? Tell.
inference: Already won everywhere, yet when won? Tell, O lord.

option_choices.reason: Already-won (labdha, won by us); attained is same winning, T1 kept.

speaker: Devotee (bowing)
question: To whom bow — clear hearts?
premises: Bow to sole dweller in clear good hearts.
White-limbed with much ash, great swan, to Śambhu.
inference: Bow to Śambhu, ash-white swan dwelling in clear hearts.

speaker: Devotee (begging lamps)
question: What lamps be mine?
premises: Dispersing surging darkness, having burned all becoming-fuel.
May your awareness-lamp be mine, O lord — your devotion-lamp.
inference: May awareness- and devotion-lamps burn darkness and fuel.
uncertainties: tānti spread vs weariness — dispersing kept, needs Kṣemarāja check.

option_choices.reason: Dispersing (present action); removal is same hṛta, T1 kept.

speaker: Devotee (marveling at poet)
question: Who but you dissolves the play?
premises: Having staged the three-world-play pregnant with true seeds.
O Hara, to dissolve — who but you is a capable poet?
inference: You staged the play; only you, poet, can dissolve it.

option_choices.reason: Dissolve (the staged play ends); gather-up is same saṃhṛ, T1 kept.
Poet (playwright of worlds); sage is same kavi, T1 poet kept.

speaker: Devotee (bowing)
question: To whom bow — free and unfree?
premises: Bow to make real-and-unreal into non-being or being indeed.
To free and unfree, to embodying-expenditure-and-dominion.
inference: Bow to the free-unfree one embodying loss and lordship.
